value.rationale: The full-coordinate critical testing threshold does not answer how to allocate a strict observation alphabet budget. This result supplies a motivated sharp information-retention phase law and an explicit optimal two-boundary observation design, showing that a vanishing fraction of possible labels retains the full asymptotic testing power. It is not a numerical table or unsupported corollary.
